test_half_normal_inference_bm_bmg: test end-to-end HalfNormal distribution inference using both BM and BMG inference engines
infer_with_ancestral_metropolis_hastings: run SingleSiteAncestralMetropolisHastings inference on queries with a specified number of samples and chains
infer_with_bmg_inference: run BMGInference on queries with a specified number of samples and chains
export_graph_to_dot: export a probabilistic program graph to DOT format using BMGInference to_dot method
export_graph_to_cpp_python: export a probabilistic program graph to C++ or Python code using BMGInference to_cpp or to_python
